PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-pre-006.text: verifyAccessToken must validate audience claim when clientId parameter is provided.
PROP-oauth-2-0-ut-pre-006.assertion: verifyAccessToken(token, clientId): clientId != undefined => jwt.verify options.audience == clientId

locations.note: audience: clientId passed to jwt.verify — when clientId is undefined, audience validation is skipped by jsonwebtoken
Calls verifyAccessToken(token) without clientId — no audience validation at userinfo endpoint
